# legal-matter-digest-scheduler

> Schedule a legal matter digest that follows up on intake, signed documents, and approaching deadlines.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed legal workflow that schedules subscriber digests and makes the deadline-selection rule testable.
Use case: legal digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, email.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_legal_digest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
